usedFor: Wordpress holds the site users, and Sangam CRM receives each one through “Create or Update Lead” after “New User Created”.

bestTemplate.name: “New User Created” in Wordpress, then “Create or Update Lead” in Sangam CRM
bestTemplate.why: A new sign-up is a lead, and the action finds or updates it by ID, email or phone.

watchOut: “User Updates Profile” also starts “Create or Update Lead”, which updates by ID, email or phone, so repeats are expected.
